CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.subscription_effective_plan(p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_plan TEXT;
BEGIN
 SELECT test_plan_code INTO v_plan FROM public.subscription_write_guard_owners
 WHERE owner_id=p_owner AND enabled AND allow_test_switch AND test_expires_at>now();
 IF v_plan IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_plan; END IF;
 -- Billing/promotion writers are intentionally not activated by this migration.
 SELECT plan_code INTO v_plan FROM public.subscription_accounts WHERE owner_id=p_owner
   AND plan_source='admin' AND billing_status='none' AND entitlement_status IN ('active','grace')
   AND (entitlement_ends_at IS NULL OR entitlement_ends_at>=now());
 RETURN COALESCE(v_plan,'free');
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deal_projection_totals(payload jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(revenue numeric, cost numeric, deal_count numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(payload->'manualRevenue', payload->'manual_revenue', payload->'totalAmount', payload->'total_amount'),
      SUM(COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(item->'price_at_time_of_sale', item->'priceAtTimeOfSale', item->'price'), 0)
        * COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(item->'quantity'), 0)), 0),
    COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(payload->'manualCost', payload->'manual_cost', payload->'totalCost', payload->'total_cost'),
      SUM(COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(item->'cost_at_time_of_sale', item->'costAtTimeOfSale', item->'cost'), 0)
        * COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(item->'quantity'), 0)), 0),
    COALESCE(public.deal_projection_number(payload->'manualDealCount', payload->'manual_deal_count', payload->'dealCount', payload->'deal_count'), 1)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(payload->'items') = 'array' THEN payload->'items' ELSE '[]'::JSONB END) AS items(item);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.market_region_code_is_valid(code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT code IS NULL OR code = ANY (ARRAY[
    'tw-taipei-city', 'tw-new-taipei-city', 'tw-keelung-city', 'tw-taoyuan-city',
    'tw-hsinchu-city', 'tw-hsinchu-county', 'tw-miaoli-county', 'tw-taichung-city',
    'tw-changhua-county', 'tw-nantou-county', 'tw-yunlin-county', 'tw-chiayi-city',
    'tw-chiayi-county', 'tw-tainan-city', 'tw-kaohsiung-city', 'tw-pingtung-county',
    'tw-yilan-county', 'tw-hualien-county', 'tw-taitung-county', 'tw-penghu-county',
    'tw-kinmen-county', 'tw-lienchiang-county'
  ]::TEXT[]);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_owned_market_ids() RETURNS TABLE(id uuid) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ SELECT id FROM public.markets WHERE owner_id = auth.uid(); $function$
